theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by 
  intro d e f h
  have h₁ : relation d e := h.1
  have h₂ : relation e f := h.2
  have h₃ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h₄ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) := (hrelation d e).mp h₁ |>.2 i
    have h₅ : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
      simp only [hdigits_to_num]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      by_cases h : j = i
      · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
        <;> ring
      · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul, add_zero]
    rw [h₅] at h₄
    exact h₄
  have h₄ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h₅ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) := (hrelation e f).mp h₂ |>.2 i
    have h₆ : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
      simp only [hdigits_to_num]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      by_cases h : j = i
      · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
        <;> ring
      · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul, add_zero]
    rw [h₆] at h₅
    exact h₅
  have h₅ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    have h₆ : digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d = ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
      simp only [hdigits_to_num]
      <;> ring
    have h₇ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d := by
      intro i; exact h₃ i
    have h₈ : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9, ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d) := by
      apply Finset.dvd_sum
      intro i _; exact h₇ i
    have h₉ : ∑ i : Fin 9, ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d) = (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d) + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      <;> ring
    rw [h₉] at h₈
    have h₁₀ : (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d) + 9 * digits_to_num d = digits_to_num e + 2 * digits_to_num d := by ring
    rw [h₁₀] at h₈
    have h₁₁ : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d := by use digits_to_num d; ring
    have h₁₂ : digits_to_num e + 2 * digits_to_num d = (digits_to_num e + 9 * digits_to_num d) - 7 * digits_to_num d := by ring
    rw [h₁₂] at h₈
    exact dvd_sub h₈ h₁₁
  have h₆ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h₇ : 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num e := h₄ i
    have h₈ : 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d := h₃ i
    have h₉ : 7 ∣ ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num e) - (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d) := dvd_sub h₇ h₅
    have h₁₀ : ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num e) - (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d) = (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 - digits_to_num d := by ring
    rw [h₁₀] at h₉
    have h₁₁ : 7 ∣ ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 - digits_to_num d) + ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d) := dvd_add h₉ h₈
    have h₁₂ : ((f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 - digits_to_num d) + ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d) = (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by ring
    rw [h₁₂] at h₁₁
    exact h₁₁
  have h₇ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ f i - d i := by
    intro i
    have h₈ : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := h₆ i
    have h₉ : ¬(7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
      intro h
      have h₁₀ : (7 : ℕ) ∣ (10 : ℕ) ^ i.1 := by norm_cast at h ⊢; exact h
      have h₁₁ : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := by
        exact Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow (by decide) h₁₀
      norm_num at h₁₁
    have h₁₀ : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (f i - d i) ∨ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
      apply (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)).dvd_mul.mp
      exact h₈
    cases h₁₀ with
    | inl h₁₀ => exact h₁₀
    | inr h₁₀ => exfalso; exact h₉ h₁₀
  intro i; exact h₇ i
